proof_checkpoints.title: Abstract and precise scope
proof_checkpoints.must_preserve: Exclude radiative UHP modes for every strictly subextremal asymptotically flat KN background; charged proof is for the full coupled system; Kerr proof includes exceptional horizon frequencies; no decay or nonradiative classification claim.

proof_checkpoints.title: Context and distinct earlier results
proof_checkpoints.must_preserve: Real-frequency exclusion does not imply UHP exclusion; retain the separate negative-spin Kerr input and context references without presenting numerical evidence as proof.

proof_checkpoints.title: Global assumptions and theorem
proof_checkpoints.must_preserve: Real M,a,Q; M>0; a²+Q²<M²; integer m; complex omega with gamma=Im omega>0; fixed e^{-i omega t+i m phi} convention; outgoing smooth perturbations have vanishing gravitational and electromagnetic radiative data.

proof_checkpoints.title: Two scientific branches
proof_checkpoints.must_preserve: For Q≠0 prove both entire four-component necessary PDE systems vanish, with algebraic transformations valid at complex frequency; Q=0 has its own Kerr full-field argument rather than a singular charge limit.

proof_checkpoints.title: Geometry and phase conventions
proof_checkpoints.must_preserve: Retain Delta,r±,delta,K and H with its integration base 2r+; K has the minus sign relative to K_std.

proof_checkpoints.title: Physical boundary conditions
proof_checkpoints.must_preserve: Retain all five horizon-weight descriptions for original variables, regular ingoing-tetrad smoothness, H-times-original-variable polynomial conormal infinity bounds for fixed radial/angular derivatives, exponential outgoing decay at gamma>0, and smooth spin-weighted sections at the axis.

proof_checkpoints.title: Exclusions from the claim
proof_checkpoints.must_preserve: Do not add gauge/parameter classification, decay, nonlinear stability, extremality or estimates uniform to extremality.

proof_checkpoints.title: Charged constants and algebraic identities
proof_checkpoints.must_preserve: Q≠0; d,eta,h,kappa,c,beta,xi0,Ktilde; c and beta retain signed Q; kappa²-c²=1 and beta*c=3h/2.

proof_checkpoints.title: Invertible original-to-transformed maps
